New historic NanoGPT record at 39.9s (-27.7s) from @DevenPzak, obliterating the prior record of 67.6s!
This record introduces a new paradigm of thinking to NanoGPT: instead of optimizing matmuls or adding more expressive operations, optimize at the individual flop level with incredibly clever engineering and ML judgement.
If a flop is low value on a particular step, skip it.
Specifically:
-(~8s) Sampled softmax. If a token doesn't appear in a batch, skip its Im_head fwd/bwd some fraction of the time.
-Sparse values. Only run an optimizer step for ngram embeddings that occurred in the batch.
Set betal to zero to enable this. Beta2 is applied retroactively when the row is later used.
-Sparse updates. Only update ngram and value embeddings once every 4 steps instead of once every 2.
-Sparse communication. Shard the n-gram table across GPUs, and only pass the rows receiving updates on each step.

Hi,
Tomorrow we are re-opening the Pro $200
subscriptions to new subscribers, but together with it we are also changing how we calculate the usage for it. In effect, if you do the math, it will net out at half the dollar in API spend compared to the old Pro $200 plan.
Now that it's said, let me explain why this is happening and why you will still get more work done than if you were on the Pro $200 subscription one month ago.
(a) We didn't want to compromise in other ways and are committing to not reintroducing the 5h limit, so that you can fully use the weekly usage when you want.
(b) On the subscription, we guarantee that over time you always get more work done and with an increasing level of quality. This means that you will continue to get more value per dollar spent as a result of models getting more efficient and us passing down the improvements in the form of API price reductions.

(c) We don't want to put an incentive on ourselves to artificially inflate the API list prices to make it look like you are getting a lot (and workaround it through discounts, etc). Instead we want to continue to both rapidly reduce prices and increase capabilities of models on the API. This week we introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna at 50% of their previous price.
Over time, we see prices go low enough that it makes sense for most to buy usage as needed without there being a significant gap between what you get in a subscription and what you get in the API for a dollar spent.
(d) Tomorrow, we are adding more things to the subscription that won't draw on the usage, I won't reveal what that is yet.
I wanted to be transparent before all the big announcements tomorrow. Lots of new exciting things are coming to the subscriptions that will make it super compelling, but I wanted to make sure to share this change ahead of time so you can all understand it before we shower you with good news.

The dragon is feeding slowly: delicate streams of visual identity rise from the archive and disappear into its mouth, while blank white forms remain behind. scattered thoughts on slutcon the morning after

1. slutcon was extremely healing for me personally. there were several specific women i interacted with (flirtily but non-sexually) who together helped me forgive myself for something in my past involving a woman i loved that i haven't forgiven myself for in 8 years. i am more grateful than i can really express for this, and it might not be an exaggeration to call it life-changing

2. slutcon is a very wholesome event disguised somewhat as a degenerate event. nearly everyone in the discourse is way overupdating on a combination of the name and aella's reputation and vague rumors about CNC parties, plus some reports about last year (which i can't speak to as i wasn't there, but the first year of an event is always difficult, and afaik they took a lot of feedback and made a lot of changes for this year). slutcon is not a CNC party, it is not really a sex party, it is not about promiscuity, it was not filled with sex workers, the women did not have to be promiscuous or kinky or polyamorous or sexually available, women do not have to be any of those things to be in this community or adjacent communities. nearly all of you are projecting intensely based on almost zero information about the event itself

3a. the actual point of slutcon, as i see it, is to teach men that they are allowed to be attracted to women and to act on that attraction (with, of course, appropriate discernment), and to give them tools, ideas, encouragement, and a very unusually real and specifically designed context to practice doing this well, in a way that is delightful for both men and women

3b. this is a meaningful project. it is an attempt to fix the debilitating side effects of the last few decades of feminist discourse (and other major societal shifts, eg the rise of digital addiction) which have, frankly, castrated an entire generation of men. this has been extremely bad for people of all genders in ways that should be obvious to all of you. i…

3c. it is necessarily the case that encouraging men to flirt with women more will make more women uncomfortable (unless you are able to very significantly increase their skill level at the same time, which is hard). obviously there is much more that can be done that it would be good to do to ameliorate this, but at slutcon itself women were extremely empowered to say no to anything and to raise safety concerns with the staff, and as far as i know every woman i saw there felt very safe and capable of doing that. in the broader world, again, obviously there is much to be done, but if you aren't willing to make any tradeoffs wrt female discomfort you are moving towards a world in which flirting is illegal, which, i cannot stress this enough, is extremely bad for everyone

3d. lurking beneath this discourse is the specter of rape. this is much too large a subject to get into here, but i'll note that insofar as humanity in general and many women in particular have significant karma involving rape, there is meaningful work to do in confronting that karma, and kink and CNC specifically have something to do with this

4a. at the time that slutcon was named, the baleful eye of sauron had not concentrated itself on the rationalist and AI safety communities to anywhere near the degree that it has now. i see it as a kind of joke that went way further than it was supposed to. you should understand the organizers as, in a very fundamental way, dorks. if i were in charge i would rename it to flirtcon, which would be significantly more accurate

4b. there is a jewish idea of mar'it ayin, which (as i understand it) has to do with not only avoiding sin but also avoiding the appearance of sin, as in doing actions that are in fact fine but could be interpreted by an onlooker as sinful. the idea is that doing fake sin is confusing and might encourage others to sin. slutcon is arguably a violation of this principle, which is the strongest case i can make in favor of changing its name to …
